race.comment: Very good race. FIELDS OF COURAGE (1) is hard to fault winning back-to-back races here over the same trip. In great form and looks hard to beat again. CAPITOL HILL (2) was runner-up fresh then not far away last time. Can only be fitter and expected to improve sharply. MAGARTEN (4) has been safely held in two runs back but is a third-up winner. Expected to improve sharply. HENNESSY LAD (3) races on speed and was narrowly beaten two back then not far away last start. Gets his chance. VIERI 97) is fitter for three runs from a spell, the latest when fifth here over a mile. Should be near his top and won't find a better chance to find form.
